children: Tempest secured an exclusive option to license Senlang’s CD7-targeted lentiviral in vivo CAR-T platform, including a BCMA/GPRC5D candidate in Phase 1 with early signs of in vivo CAR-T generation and no ≥Grade 3 CRS or ICANS reported as of Aug. 25, 2026.
Exclusive option to license CD7 LV platform
Expands Tempest’s tech stack and optionality in in vivo CAR-T without upfront acquisition risk.
Clinical-stage asset could accelerate Tempest’s multiple myeloma roadmap if licensed.
Early in vivo CAR-T generation observed
Signals platform feasibility; positive for de-risking if replicated with more data.
Initial safety supports dose escalation; safety is key for adoption and regulators.
Complements Tempest’s LNP in vivo platform
Two delivery modalities (LNP, LV) broaden targeting and durability options.

This is an early-to-mid stage strategic move to build a multi-platform in vivo CAR-T franchise alongside Tempest’s LNP program. A firm license execution plus stronger Phase 1 efficacy data would turn this into a larger catalyst.
